import APPTReview.AsymptoticUpper
import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Finset.Fin

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview

/-- The all-ones test retains the linear gap budget, not only a norm bound. -/
theorem gap_mass_cap {m : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i j, G i j=G j i) (hd : ∀ i, G i i=0)
    (hp : (c • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)-G).PosSemidef) :
    2*(∑ p : UpperPair m, G p.val.1 p.val.2) ≤ (m:ℝ)*c := by
  have hq := hp.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (fun _ => (1:ℝ))
  have he := symmetric_degree_mass G hs hd
  simp [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hq
  nlinarith

/-- The last large eigenvalue and the paper's lower-tail pivot bound a bulk
interval of ratio (m+1)/(m-1). All eigenvalue placement is physical. -/
theorem density_appt_bulk_ratio {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n)
    {A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) (happt : APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A)
    (hR : 0<Fintype.card (UpperPair m)) :
    ((m:ℝ)-1) * hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
      (finalTop hR (gapPrefixBound hmn)) ≤
      ((m:ℝ)+1)*hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ (pairedPivot (by omega) hmn) := by
  let R := Fintype.card (UpperPair m)
  let f := hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
  let b := f (pairedPivot (by omega) hmn)
  let t := f (finalTop hR (gapPrefixBound hmn))
  let G := gapMatrix (placedSpectrum hmn (rowRank m) f)
  have hw := appt_all_ordered_pair_witnesses hmn hρ.1.isHermitian happt (rowRank m)
  have hG := gapMatrix_hermitian _ hw
  have hsym (i j : Fin m) : G i j=G j i := by
    have he := congrArg (fun M => M j i) hG.eq
    simpa [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] using he
  have hcap := gap_mass_cap G (2*b) hsym (gapMatrix_diag _)
    (witness_gap_psd_bound _ b hw
      (placedSpectrum_diagonal_le (by omega) hmn (rowRank m) f
        hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone))
  have hsum : (∑ p : UpperPair m, G p.val.1 p.val.2) =
      ∑ i : Fin R, sortedGap (gapPrefixBound hmn) f i := by
    dsimp only [G]
    simp_rw [placed_gap_eq_sortedGap]
    exact (rowRank m).sum_comp _
  rw [hsum] at hcap
  have hlo (i : Fin R) : t-b ≤ sortedGap (gapPrefixBound hmn) f i := by
    have htop : t ≤ f (Fin.castLE (gapPrefixBound hmn) i) := by
      apply hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone
      change i.val ≤ R-1
      omega
    have hbot : f (Fin.rev (Fin.castLE (gapPrefixBound hmn) i)) ≤ b := by
      apply hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone
      change Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n)-R-m ≤
        Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n)-(i.val+1)
      have hi := i.isLt
      have hc := pairPlacementBound hmn
      omega
    dsimp [sortedGap]
    linarith
  have hl := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i∈Finset.univ) => hlo i)
  have hl' : (R:ℝ)*(t-b) ≤ ∑ i : Fin R, sortedGap (gapPrefixBound hmn) f i := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at hl
    exact hl
  have hcN := upperPair_card m
  have hc : 2*(R:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)=(m:ℝ)^2 := by
    dsimp [R]
    simpa only [pow_two] using (show 2*(Fintype.card (UpperPair m):ℝ)+(m:ℝ)=(m:ℝ)*(m:ℝ) by exact_mod_cast hcN)
  have hmR : (0:ℝ)<m := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0<m)
  change ((m:ℝ)-1)*t ≤ ((m:ℝ)+1)*b
  by_contra hbad
  have hneg : 0<(m:ℝ)*(((m:ℝ)-1)*t-((m:ℝ)+1)*b) :=
    mul_pos hmR (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hbad))
  have he : (m:ℝ)*(((m:ℝ)-1)*t-((m:ℝ)+1)*b) =
      2*(R:ℝ)*(t-b)-2*(m:ℝ)*b := by
    have heq := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x*(t-b)) hc
    nlinarith [heq]
  rw [he] at hneg
  nlinarith

end APPTReview

import APPTReview.AsymptoticUpper
import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Finset.Fin

open scoped BigOperators
namespace APPTReview

/-- Exact interval second-moment inequality, retaining total bulk mass. -/
theorem interval_square_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ)
    (b r : ℝ) (hl : ∀ i∈s, b≤f i) (hu : ∀ i∈s, f i≤r*b) :
    (∑ i∈s, (f i)^2) ≤ (r+1)*b*(∑ i∈s, f i)-(s.card:ℝ)*r*b^2 := by
  have ht (i) (hi : i∈s) : (f i)^2≤(r+1)*b*f i-r*b^2 := by
    have hh := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hl i hi)) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hu i hi))
    nlinarith
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum ht
  simpa [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc] using hs

/-- Complete the square without assuming a value of the optimizing interval. -/
theorem interval_moment_bound {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℝ)
    (b r : ℝ) (hb : 0≤b) (hr : 0<r) (hL : 0<s.card)
    (hl : ∀ i∈s, b≤f i) (hu : ∀ i∈s, f i≤r*b)
    (hmass : (∑ i∈s, f i)≤1) :
    (∑ i∈s, (f i)^2) ≤ (r+1)^2/(4*r*(s.card:ℝ)) := by
  have hLR : (0:ℝ)<s.card := by exact_mod_cast hL
  have hcoeff : 0≤(r+1)*b := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hb
  have hx := interval_square_sum s f b r hl hu
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass hcoeff
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<4*r*(s.card:ℝ))).2
  have hs := sq_nonneg (2*r*(s.card:ℝ)*b-(r+1))
  have hd := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx.trans (by nlinarith :
    (r+1)*b*(∑ i∈s, f i)-(s.card:ℝ)*r*b^2≤(r+1)*b-(s.card:ℝ)*r*b^2))
    (show 0≤4*r*(s.card:ℝ) by positivity)
  nlinarith

/-- Bound exceptional eigenvalues individually rather than discard them. -/
theorem bulk_exception_moment {D : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin D)) (f : Fin D → ℝ)
    (b r B : ℝ) (hb : 0≤b) (hr : 0<r) (hB : 0≤B) (hL : 0<s.card)
    (hf : ∀ i, 0≤f i) (hs : (∑ i, f i)=1) (hmax : ∀ i, f i≤B)
    (hl : ∀ i∈s, b≤f i) (hu : ∀ i∈s, f i≤r*b) :
    (∑ i, (f i)^2) ≤ (r+1)^2/(4*r*(s.card:ℝ))+
      ((D:ℝ)-(s.card:ℝ))*B^2 := by
  classical
  have hmass : (∑ i∈s, f i)≤1 := by
    rw [← hs]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (fun i _ _ => hf i)
  have hbulk := interval_moment_bound s f b r hb hr hL hl hu hmass
  have htail : (∑ i∈sᶜ, (f i)^2)≤((D:ℝ)-(s.card:ℝ))*B^2 := by
    have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i∈sᶜ) =>
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (hf i) (hmax i) 2)
    have hc : (sᶜ.card:ℝ)=(D:ℝ)-(s.card:ℝ) := by
      have hsz : s.card≤D := by simpa using Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ s)
      simp only [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_sub hsz]
    simpa [hc] using hh
  have he := Finset.sum_add_sum_compl s (fun i => (f i)^2)
  linarith

end APPTReview

namespace APPTReview
/-- A dimension-scaled bulk bound with an explicit exceptional-rank error. -/
theorem bulk_rescale_bound (D L C K p : ℝ)
    (hD : 0<D) (hL : 0<L) (hCL : 0≤C) (hC : C≤2)
    (hLD : L≤D) (hDL : D≤2*L) (hK : D-L≤K)
    (hp : p≤C/L+9*(D-L)/D^2) :
    D*p≤C+13*K/D := by
  have hq : 0≤D-L := sub_nonneg.mpr hLD
  have hfrac : C/L≤4/D := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hL hD).2
    nlinarith
  have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfrac hq
  have he : D*(C/L+9*(D-L)/D^2)=C+(C/L)*(D-L)+9*(D-L)/D := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hu := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hD.le
  rw [he] at hu
  have herr : 13*(D-L)/D≤13*K/D :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hD.le
  calc
    D*p ≤ C+(C/L)*(D-L)+9*(D-L)/D := hu
    _ ≤ C+(4/D)*(D-L)+9*(D-L)/D := by linarith
    _ = C+13*(D-L)/D := by ring
    _ ≤ C+13*K/D := by linarith
end APPTReview

import FixedLocalRatio
import IntervalMoment

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview

/-- Uniform over all states, with an explicit error for a fixed first dimension. -/
theorem density_appt_fixed_local_upper {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hn : 2*m≤n)
    {A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ}
    (hρ : APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A) (happt : APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A) :
    ((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A ≤
      (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1)+13*(m:ℝ)/n := by
  classical
  have hmn : m≤n := by omega
  let D := Fintype.card (Fin m × Fin n)
  let R := Fintype.card (UpperPair m)
  have hcR := upperPair_card m
  have hR : 0<R := by dsimp [R]; nlinarith
  have hplace := pairPlacementBound hmn
  have hD2 : 2*m*m≤D := by
    dsimp [D]
    simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
    nlinarith
  let f := hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀
  let t := finalTop hR (gapPrefixBound hmn)
  let p := pairedPivot (by omega : 0<m) hmn
  let s := Finset.Icc t p
  let b := f p
  let r : ℝ := ((m:ℝ)+1)/((m:ℝ)-1)
  let C : ℝ := (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1)
  have hmR : (2:ℝ)≤m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmp : (0:ℝ)<(m:ℝ)-1 := by linarith
  have hnR : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0<n)
  have hDP : (0:ℝ)<D := by dsimp [D]; simp; positivity
  have hr : 0<r := div_pos (by linarith) hmp
  have hsCard : s.card+m*m=D+2 := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [Fin.card_Icc]
    change (D-R-m+1-(R-1))+m*m=D+2
    have h0 : 2*R+m=m*m := hcR
    have hd : 2*R+m≤D := hplace
    omega
  have hLD : s.card≤D := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ s)
    simpa [D] using h
  have hDL : D≤2*s.card := by nlinarith
  have hsP : 0<s.card := by nlinarith
  have hf : Antitone f := hρ.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀_antitone
  have hnonneg (i : Fin D) : 0≤f i := by
    have h := hρ.1.eigenvalues_nonneg (spectralLabel _ i)
    simpa only [eigenvalues_spectralLabel] using h
  have htrace : (∑ i, f i)=1 := ordered_eigenvalues_sum hρ.1.isHermitian hρ.2
  have hrank := density_appt_bulk_ratio hm hmn hρ happt hR
  have htop : f t≤r*b := by
    have he : r*b=(((m:ℝ)+1)*b)/((m:ℝ)-1) := by dsimp [r]; ring
    rw [he]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hmp).2
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hrank
  have hl (i : Fin D) (hi : i∈s) : b≤f i := hf (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hi).2
  have hu (i : Fin D) (hi : i∈s) : f i≤r*b :=
    (hf (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hi).1).trans htop
  have hfour : 4≤D := by nlinarith
  have hmax0 := appt_largest_eigenvalue_bound hm hmn hρ happt hfour
  have hmax (i : Fin D) : f i≤3/(D:ℝ) := by
    have hh : f (rankTwoLabels hfour (1,0))≤3/((D:ℝ)+2) := by simpa [D] using hmax0
    have ht : f i≤f (rankTwoLabels hfour (1,0)) := by
      apply hf
      change (0:ℕ) ≤ i.val
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    exact ht.trans (hh.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hDP (by linarith)))
  have hmoment := bulk_exception_moment s f b r (3/(D:ℝ))
    (hnonneg p) hr (by positivity) hsP hnonneg htrace hmax hl hu
  have hpC : 0<(m:ℝ)^2-1 := by nlinarith
  have hC0 : 0≤C := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hpC.le
  have hC2 : C≤2 := (div_le_iff₀ hpC).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hid : (r+1)^2/(4*r)=C := by
    dsimp [r,C]
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hid2 : (r+1)^2/(4*r*(s.card:ℝ))=C/(s.card:ℝ) := by
    rw [← div_div, hid]
  rw [hid2] at hmoment
  have hb : (∑ i, (f i)^2)≤C/(s.card:ℝ)+9*((D:ℝ)-(s.card:ℝ))/(D:ℝ)^2 := by
    convert hmoment using 1 <;> ring
  have he := bulk_rescale_bound (D:ℝ) (s.card:ℝ) C ((m:ℝ)^2)
    (∑ i, (f i)^2) hDP (by exact_mod_cast hsP) hC0 hC2
    (by exact_mod_cast hLD) (by exact_mod_cast hDL)
    (by have hc : (s.card:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)^2=(D:ℝ)+2 := by simpa only [pow_two] using (show (s.card:ℝ)+(m:ℝ)*(m:ℝ)=(D:ℝ)+2 by exact_mod_cast hsCard)
        nlinarith) hb
  have herr : 13*(m:ℝ)^2/(D:ℝ)=13*(m:ℝ)/n := by
    simp only [D,Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_mul]
    field_simp <;> ring
  rw [herr] at he
  rw [purity_eq_ordered_eigenvalues hρ.1.isHermitian]
  simpa [D,C] using he

end APPTReview

import APPTReview.AsymptoticUpper
import APPTReview.ProjectionState

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder
open Matrix
namespace APPTReview

/-- Exact deficit from the continuous rank optimum; no asymptotic substitution. -/
theorem plateau_rounding_identity (m n k : ℝ) (hm : m^2-1≠0)
    (hZ : m*n*(m-1)+2*k≠0) :
    m^2/(m^2-1)-(m*n)*((m*n*(m-1)^2+4*m*k)/(m*n*(m-1)+2*k)^2) =
      (m^2/(m^2-1))*(2*k-(m-1)*n)^2/(m*n*(m-1)+2*k)^2 := by
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_sub_div _ _ hm (pow_ne_zero 2 hZ)]
  have he : m^2*(m*n*(m-1)+2*k)^2-
      (m*n*(m*n*(m-1)^2+4*m*k))*(m^2-1)=
      m^2*(2*k-(m-1)*n)^2 := by ring
  rw [he]
  ring

/-- The actual broad-plateau density approaches the fixed-m optimum from below,
with a dimension-uniform rounding error at most 1/n^2. -/
theorem exists_appt_fixed_local_lower {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hmn : m≤n) :
    ∃ A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ,
      APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A ∧
      (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1)-1/(n:ℝ)^2 ≤ ((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A ∧
      ((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A ≤ (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1) := by
  let k := ((m-1)*n+1)/2
  have hkN : (m-1)*n≤2*k ∧ 2*k≤(m-1)*n+1 := by dsimp [k]; omega
  have hcast : (((m-1)*n:ℕ):ℝ)=((m:ℝ)-1)*n := by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1≤m), Nat.cast_one]
  have hk0 : ((m:ℝ)-1)*n≤2*(k:ℝ) := by
    rw [← hcast]
    exact_mod_cast hkN.1
  have hk1 : 2*(k:ℝ)≤((m:ℝ)-1)*n+1 := by
    rw [← hcast]
    exact_mod_cast hkN.2
  let s : ℝ := 2*(k:ℝ)-((m:ℝ)-1)*n
  let Z := plateauDenominator m n k
  let C : ℝ := (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1)
  have hmR : (2:ℝ)≤m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hnP : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0<n)
  have hmP : (0:ℝ)<m := by linarith
  have hbase : (0:ℝ)<(m:ℝ)^2-1 := by nlinarith
  have hs0 : 0≤s := by dsimp [s]; linarith
  have hs1 : s≤1 := by dsimp [s]; linarith
  have hs2 : s^2≤1 := by nlinarith
  have hC0 : 0≤C := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hbase.le
  have hCm : C≤(m:ℝ)^2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hbase).2
    have htwo : (1:ℝ)≤(m:ℝ)^2-1 := by nlinarith
    simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htwo (sq_nonneg (m:ℝ))
  have hZ : (m:ℝ)*n≤Z := by
    have hm2 : (m:ℝ)≤(m:ℝ)^2-1 := by nlinarith
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm2 hnP.le
    dsimp [Z, plateauDenominator]
    nlinarith
  have hDP : (0:ℝ)<(m:ℝ)*n := mul_pos hmP hnP
  have hZP : 0<Z := hDP.trans_le hZ
  have hCs : C*s^2≤(m:ℝ)^2 := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs2 hC0).trans (by simpa using hCm)
  have hdiff : 0≤C*s^2/Z^2 := by positivity
  have hsmall : C*s^2/Z^2≤1/(n:ℝ)^2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (m:ℝ)^2/Z^2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hCs (sq_nonneg Z)
      _ ≤ (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)*n)^2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
        (sq_nonneg _) (sq_pos_of_pos hDP) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hDP.le hZ 2)
      _ = _ := by field_simp <;> ring
  obtain ⟨A,hd,ha,hpur⟩ := exists_broad_plateau hm hmn
  have hid := plateau_rounding_identity (m:ℝ) (n:ℝ) (k:ℝ) (ne_of_gt hbase)
    (show (m:ℝ)*n*((m:ℝ)-1)+2*(k:ℝ)≠0 from ne_of_gt hZP)
  have hq : C-((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A=C*s^2/Z^2 := by
    rw [hpur]
    exact hid
  refine ⟨A,hd,ha,?_,?_⟩
  · change C-1/(n:ℝ)^2≤((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A
    linarith
  · change ((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A≤C
    linarith

end APPTReview

import FixedLocalUpper
import PlateauApproximation
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Pseudo.Defs

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder Topology
open Matrix Filter
namespace APPTReview

/-- The objective set consists of scaled purities of genuine APPT density matrices. -/
def scaledAPPTPurities (m n : ℕ) : Set ℝ :=
  {x | ∃ A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ,
    APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A ∧
    x=((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A}

noncomputable def scaledAPPTPuritySup (m n : ℕ) : ℝ := sSup (scaledAPPTPurities m n)

/-- A finite two-sided estimate for the true spectral optimization, with an
actual attaining-family lower bound and an unrestricted physical upper bound. -/
theorem fixed_local_sup_bounds {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hn : 2*m≤n) :
    (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1)-1/(n:ℝ)^2 ≤ scaledAPPTPuritySup m n ∧
    scaledAPPTPuritySup m n ≤ (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1)+13*(m:ℝ)/n := by
  obtain ⟨A,hd,ha,hlo,hhi⟩ := exists_appt_fixed_local_lower hm (by omega : m≤n)
  have hmem : ((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A ∈ scaledAPPTPurities m n :=
    ⟨A,hd,ha,rfl⟩
  have hub (x : ℝ) (hx : x∈scaledAPPTPurities m n) :
      x≤(m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1)+13*(m:ℝ)/n := by
    obtain ⟨B,hB,hp,rfl⟩ := hx
    exact density_appt_fixed_local_upper hm hn hB hp
  have hbd : BddAbove (scaledAPPTPurities m n) := ⟨_,hub⟩
  exact ⟨hlo.trans (le_csSup hbd hmem), csSup_le ⟨_,hmem⟩ hub⟩

/-- The complementary fixed-first-dimension asymptotic is proved as an actual
filter limit of the supremum over physical states, not a formal parameter substitution. -/
theorem appt_fixed_local_scaled_sup_tendsto (m : ℕ) (hm : 2≤m) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => scaledAPPTPuritySup m n) atTop
      (𝓝 ((m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1))) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.2
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (2*(m:ℝ)) (26*(m:ℝ)/ε))
  refine ⟨N,?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hnR : (N:ℝ)≤n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnm : 2*(m:ℝ)<n := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt (hN.trans_le hnR)
  have hne : 26*(m:ℝ)/ε<(n:ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt (hN.trans_le hnR)
  have hnNat : 2*m≤n := by exact_mod_cast hnm.le
  have hmR : (2:ℝ)≤m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hnP : (0:ℝ)<n := by linarith
  have hn1 : (1:ℝ)≤n := by linarith
  have hmul : 26*(m:ℝ)<(n:ℝ)*ε := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).1 hne
  have herr : 13*(m:ℝ)/(n:ℝ)<ε := (div_lt_iff₀ hnP).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hsmall : 1/(n:ℝ)^2 ≤ 13*(m:ℝ)/(n:ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 1/(n:ℝ) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hnP (by nlinarith)
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) hnP.le
  have hb := fixed_local_sup_bounds hm hnNat
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  apply abs_lt.2
  constructor <;> linarith [hb.1,hb.2]

end APPTReview

namespace APPTReview

def apptPurityValues (m n : ℕ) : Set ℝ :=
  {x | ∃ A : Matrix (Fin m × Fin n) (Fin m × Fin n) ℂ,
    APPT.Quantum.IsDensity A ∧ APPT.Quantum.AbsolutelyPPT A ∧ x=APPT.Quantum.purity A}

noncomputable def apptPuritySup (m n : ℕ) : ℝ := sSup (apptPurityValues m n)

/-- Scaling the objective is justified for the actual nonempty bounded state set. -/
theorem scaled_sup_eq_dimension_mul_purity_sup {m n : ℕ} (hm : 2≤m) (hn : 2*m≤n) :
    scaledAPPTPuritySup m n=((m:ℝ)*n)*apptPuritySup m n := by
  have hD : (0:ℝ)<(m:ℝ)*n := by
    have hmP : (0:ℝ)<m := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0<m)
    have hnP : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0<n)
    positivity
  let U : ℝ := (m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1)+13*(m:ℝ)/n
  obtain ⟨A,hd,ha,_,_⟩ := exists_appt_fixed_local_lower hm (by omega : m≤n)
  have hmem : APPT.Quantum.purity A∈apptPurityValues m n := ⟨A,hd,ha,rfl⟩
  have hsmem : ((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity A∈scaledAPPTPurities m n := ⟨A,hd,ha,rfl⟩
  have hsbound (x) (hx : x∈scaledAPPTPurities m n) : x≤U := by
    obtain ⟨B,hB,hp,rfl⟩ := hx
    exact density_appt_fixed_local_upper hm hn hB hp
  have hpbound (x) (hx : x∈apptPurityValues m n) : x≤U/((m:ℝ)*n) := by
    obtain ⟨B,hB,hp,rfl⟩ := hx
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hD).2
    simpa only [mul_comm] using density_appt_fixed_local_upper hm hn hB hp
  have hsbdd : BddAbove (scaledAPPTPurities m n) := ⟨U,hsbound⟩
  have hpbdd : BddAbove (apptPurityValues m n) := ⟨_,hpbound⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply csSup_le ⟨_,hsmem⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨B,hB,hp,rfl⟩ := hx
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_csSup hpbdd ⟨B,hB,hp,rfl⟩) hD.le
  · have hle : apptPuritySup m n≤scaledAPPTPuritySup m n/((m:ℝ)*n) := by
      apply csSup_le ⟨_,hmem⟩
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨B,hB,hp,rfl⟩ := hx
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hD).2
      simpa only [mul_comm] using (le_csSup hsbdd
        (show ((m:ℝ)*n)*APPT.Quantum.purity B∈scaledAPPTPurities m n from ⟨B,hB,hp,rfl⟩))
    simpa only [mul_comm] using (le_div_iff₀ hD).1 hle

/-- The fixed-local purity-supremum asymptotic in the paper's normalization. -/
theorem appt_fixed_local_purity_sup_tendsto (m : ℕ) (hm : 2≤m) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((m:ℝ)*n)*apptPuritySup m n) atTop
      (𝓝 ((m:ℝ)^2/((m:ℝ)^2-1))) := by
  apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' _ (appt_fixed_local_scaled_sup_tendsto m hm)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (2*m)] with n hn
  exact scaled_sup_eq_dimension_mul_purity_sup hm hn

end APPTReview
